next_question.rationale: Consultation-trigger and delivery_channel already show the loss concentrates in instant/online requests (consultation_trigger: "instant" entered 181,651 converted 94,141 rate 0.5183 — that matches the top_gap lost ≈87,511). Before concluding routing/availability is the primary mechanism, test whether the client/interface or payment method explains part of the created→confirmed drop. Request interface_type to check whether a particular client (Android/iOS/web) has higher ‘abandoned by system’ or timeout behavior (e.g. session/API differences). Also request payment_method as a second cut to check whether certain payment flows (insurance, unpaid, wallet, card) have materially worse created→confirmed conversion — if so the mechanism is payments rather than doctor availability.
